OQ-01's actual question is 'effective Roth' — make the constant c(α,ε) in Roth's |α-p/q| > c/q^(2+ε) computable from α and ε. This is genuinely open in mathematics; partial effective bounds exist (Bombieri, Schmidt, Evertse) but only for restricted classes; no Mathlib infrastructure for it.
